summary: MoneyHero Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 29, 2026, announcing the resignation of director Rohith Murthy, effective May 26, 2026. The press release includes only a routine director departure with a thank-you statement from the Chairman and no special-situation terms, activist campaign, tender offer, or strategic review. No price, premium, or deal mechanics are mentioned. This is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer, not a special situation.
